## Overview

The May 6, 2026 guide describes saving Pix details through hosted Checkout or the Direct API. Recurring use requires a customer-authorized Pix Automático mandate. Attach the PaymentMethod to the object representing the customer, either a Customer or a customer-configured Account. The May guide describes Accounts v2 as generally available for Connect users and in public preview for other Stripe users, with a preview version required for enrollees. The November 7, 2026 capture provides navigation to the two variants.

## May setup and payment paths

| Path | Save without charging | Pay and save |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hosted Checkout | Create the Session in `setup` mode and send the customer to the returned Session URL. When they complete Checkout and authorize in their banking app, the SetupIntent succeeds and Checkout attaches the saved method. | Create a `payment` mode Session with `payment_method_options.pix.setup_future_usage: 'off_session'`. Payment and bank-app mandate authorization precede saving and attachment. |
| Direct API | Create a SetupIntent server-side and call `stripe.confirmPixSetup()` with the SetupIntent client secret and `return_url`. Verify the SetupIntent on return. The setup can succeed and attach the method after customer authorization without an initial charge. | Set `setup_future_usage: 'off_session'` on PaymentIntent creation. Call `stripe.confirmPixPayment()` with that Intent's client secret and `return_url`. Verify the PaymentIntent on return. Payment success and bank-app mandate authorization precede saving the method. |

The Direct API examples collect name, email and `tax_id` (CPF for an individual or CNPJ for a business). The stated Brazilian government tax-ID requirement applies to cross-border transactions. React's Elements provider wiring belongs to the Direct API variant. See May lines 27–41, 72–145, 222–278, 351–380, 453–542 and 563–689.

The examples put `amount` and `payment_schedule` in `payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options`, and the Direct API prose tells implementers to provide Pix Automático mandate options. The May 6 [Pix Automático customization guide](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/pix/pix-automatico) lists defaults of 400 BRL and monthly. The May 13 Direct Subscriptions API guide makes the options optional for that route and shows an amount-only configuration. These are route-specific instructions, examples and defaults. See May save-guide lines 76–108, 248–278 and 351–380, customization lines 53–67, and subscription guide lines 688–722.

## QR instructions and outcome

Stripe.js can display the instructions. If the merchant sets `handleActions: false` for manual display, read `next_action.pix_display_qr_code` on the matching Intent. The May examples show the EMV copy-and-paste value `data`, QR images `image_url_svg` and `image_url_png`, expiration `expires_at` and `hosted_instructions_url`. Displaying or scanning the QR and returning to the site are intermediate steps. Check the matching Intent status to determine the setup or payment outcome. See May lines 563–803.

## Later payment, retry and revocation

Create and confirm a separate PaymentIntent for the customer with the saved PaymentMethod ID. Set `off_session: true` when the customer is outside checkout. The May guide says Stripe retries failures unrelated to a mandate violation. After exhausted retries, bring the customer back on-session for a new payment.

The Pix scheme limits charges to once per cycle specified by the mandate's `payment_schedule`. Bring the customer back on-session for an add-on that requires a further charge in that cycle. If the customer revokes the Pix mandate in their banking app, Stripe sends `mandate.updated`. Bring the customer back on-session to create a new mandate. See May lines 147–168 and 805–870.

## Test boundaries

Use the test QR simulation to authorize or expire a test attempt. In the live flow the customer needs a Brazilian bank account with Pix enabled. The May test email scenarios include an active mandate with later payments expiring immediately or after three minutes, and a separate immediate-success case. See May lines 170–201 and 829–860 for the fixture strings and webhook outcomes.

payments-pix-save-payment-details.text: Learn how to save Pix payment details and charge your customers later.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:
After the customer authorizes the mandate in their banking app, the SetupIntent moves to a `succeeded` state and the PaymentMethod is attached to the Customer.
If the payment fails after exhausting all of the retries, you can bring your customer back on-session to create a new payment.
Due to scheme restrictions, you can only charge a Pix payment method once per cycle

payments-pix-save-payment-details.Q1: The November 7, 2026 base capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/pix/save-payment-details identifies saving Pix details for a later charge and indexes Checkout and Direct API (new raw lines 5-14). It supplies no implementation prerequisites or state transitions. The May 6, 2026 guide explains that a merchant attaches the method to a Customer or customer-configured Account, and the customer authorizes a Pix Automático mandate in their banking app (old raw lines 8-10, 27-41 and 53-55). Checkout setup mode or Direct API SetupIntent saves without an initial charge. Checkout payment mode or a Direct API PaymentIntent using off-session future usage needs successful payment and mandate authorization before saving. On the direct return page, check the matching SetupIntent or PaymentIntent status; QR display and browser return do not prove setup or payment (old raw lines 72-145, 248-278, 351-380 and 563-689). Later qualifying attempts use the saved method and revocation emits mandate.updated (old raw lines 805-827). source-stripe-pix-save-payment-details.md now distinguishes the mandate-option scope and preserves both the cycle limit and the setup or payment verification boundary.
payments-pix-save-payment-details.Q2: The change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/pix/save-payment-details is presentational/navigation only (new raw lines 9-14) and supplies no substantive rule change. source-stripe-pix-save-payment-details.md should retain the May 6, 2026 instructions and examples for Pix Automático, but avoid a universal requirement that amount and payment_schedule be supplied. The May save guide tells Direct API users to provide mandate options and uses both fields in examples (old raw lines 248-278 and 351-380). The May 6 customization document lists 400 BRL and monthly defaults, and the separate May 13 direct Subscriptions API guide calls the options optional (raw/stripe-pix-automatico-2025.md lines 53-67 and raw/stripe-subscriptions-pix-2026.md lines 688-722). Preserve setup without charge versus payment and save, the cross-border CPF/CNPJ scope, revocation, the once-per-cycle limit and on-session recovery after retries or for an add-on (old raw lines 72-145, 453-485 and 825-870). Preserve root index line 7, Stripe index lines 360, 685 and 748, and Real-Time Payments concept line 208. The updated source links both concepts and places the November selector in its separate navigation section.

concept_suggestions.anchor: **Save/recurring (Pix Automático)**: Checkout and Direct API only (no Elements). Requires `mandate_options` (`amount`, `payment_schedule`) in `payment_method_options.pix`. Direct API uses `stripe.confirmPixSetup()` (SetupIntent) or `stripe.confirmPixPayment()` (PaymentIntent + `setup_future_usage: off_session`). QR data exposed via `next_action.pix_display_qr_code` (`data`, `image_url_svg`, `image_url_png`, `expires_at`, `hosted_instructions_url`). Mandate revocation → `mandate.updated` event → bring customer back on-session.
concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown: **May 2026 save/recurring (Pix Automático).** Checkout and Direct API require a customer-authorized mandate. The save guide illustrates `amount` and `payment_schedule`; the separate customization and subscription guides distinguish defaults from route-specific choices. Direct API uses `stripe.confirmPixSetup()` for setup without charging or `stripe.confirmPixPayment()` with off-session future usage to pay and save. QR instructions are available through the matching Intent's `next_action`. A saved method can charge once per specified cycle, and mandate revocation sends `mandate.updated` and calls for a new on-session mandate. See [[source-stripe-pix-save-payment-details]].
